name: Custom Generators
tagline: Build the button. Share the button.
description:
Custom Generators turns a set of generation settings into buttons anyone can press.

Build one in the builder: give it a name, a cover image, and as many buttons as you like. Each button is a saved preset — a checkpoint, up to five weighted LoRAs, a prompt template, and optional params like steps, CFG, size and quantity. Put `{prompt}` anywhere in a template and a prompt box appears for whoever runs it; set a button to Image → Image and they get a source-image upload too. A live preview sits beside the editor, so you see exactly what runners will see.

Save it as a draft, or publish it and it lands in Discover for everyone. Browse what other people have built: search, sort by newest or popular, upvote, copy a share link, or hit Make a copy to fork someone's generator into your own editable draft. Anything you publish, you can withdraw again.

Running a generator spends your Buzz, and it always asks first. Press a button and you get a cost estimate for that exact generation, then a Confirm step before a single Buzz leaves your balance. If the estimate is more than you have, Confirm is blocked and you are offered a top-up instead of a failed generation.

scopeJustifications.ai:write:budgeted: Spends the viewer's Buzz to run the generator's one-tap image generations, capped per generation by the manifest page.buzzBudgetPerGen and gated behind an explicit estimate + Confirm step.
scopeJustifications.buzz:read:self: Reads the viewer's Buzz balance to display it and to block Confirm when a generation's estimated cost exceeds the available balance, offering a top-up instead of a failed spend.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:read: Reads the viewer's own app-scoped drafts so they can resume editing generators they previously saved.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:write: Saves the viewer's own generator drafts to their app-scoped storage so work persists between sessions.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:shared:read: Lists published generators from shared storage to populate the Discover feed that all users browse.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:shared:write: Publishes, updates, and withdraws the viewer's own generators in shared storage so other users can find and run them in Discover.
